title: Planning supervision from whole human scores — the section-level plan the human built, with measured quality filters (PR-78)

run.sample: full pass over every admitted file

method.sections: formSegmentation.segmentForm (Foote novelty, kernel 4 bars, labels by aligned-diagonal similarity), bar grid honouring every written metre
method.stability: the same self-similarity matrix re-cut with kernel 6 bars; boundary F1 at ±1 bar must reach 0.67 with ≥ 3 sections under both
method.families: ARRANGER_REMI family per (track, channel); a family counts with ≥ 8 notes in ≥ 2 bars; active in a section when sounding in ≥ 25 % of its bars
method.energy: cbrt(densityRel × velocityRel × registerWidthRel), each relative to the piece's own maximum
method.tension: 0.6 × non-chord-tone share + 0.4 × interval-class dissonance, over chordsFromNotes' named bars
method.function: naming heuristic over the repeat structure (see planningSupervision.ts guessFunctions); not a detected function
method.duplicates: nearDuplicate.ts over the multitrack works: exact hash ∪ MinHash/LSH at Jaccard ≥ 0.5; one representative (smallest id among the per-work survivors) per group

min_families.note: families dropped as fragments (< 8 notes or < 2 bars) do not count

wholeFormPopulation.definition: multitrack works yielding ≥ 1 whole_form task under arrangerTaskTypes (16–128 grid bars, ≥ 8 notes each side)

notes: energy: the model's energy curve is the extractor's per-bar proxy, so agreement is expected by construction
density: planner = melody + bass onsets per bar over the section maximum; human = all-family onsets over the piece maximum
families: planner keeps 2…N palette families by energy in tier order; palette seeds drums/bass/keys for a medium or dense stem set
roles: classified from the extractor's own section names — agreement by construction, not reported
